hyperedges.description: The critical path for production trading requires IBKR connectivity, event bus for inter-component communication, order state machine for order lifecycle management, and circuit breakers for fault tolerance
The Phase 15.5 Fundamental Analysis System encompasses ratio calculators, quality scorers, and composite scoring working together as an integrated pipeline for institutional-grade stock analysis
The polyglot persistence strategy uses PostgreSQL for ACID transactions, ClickHouse for time-series analytics, and Neo4j for knowledge graphs, each optimized for its data access patterns
